reviewer_identity: storyboard-critic claude-opus-5-5 high, isolated visual leaf, phone round 29

blocking_defects.defect: Overhead creek 13.2-17.4 s: no white water, foam or pile-up against the car or at the lip; the roof rotates and slides left off the shelf between 14.4 and 15.2 s with no visible lift (no shadow separation or scale change); in the closer shot it drifts about one car length (about 55% to 38% of frame width, 15.4-17.4 s) and stops just right of the slab; no flow cue shows downstream. 'Swept into Salado Creek' reads as a slow drift.

The lip is a thin pale cream line with small dark dots in both overhead shots, not a bold lip, and has no white water. In shot 2 (15.4-17.4 s) the shelf is a flat lighter-brown patch with a near-horizontal top edge to the right frame edge and a near-vertical left edge straight down to the lower bank, so it reads as a rounded box. The wake strokes are straight ruled lines. Fails finished_art.
Clause n3 qualifier 'empty' is not pictured: the overhead view shows only the roof and dark glass for the whole clause.

All are recognizable at phone size.

contact_and_consequence.observed: The creek current shows no white water or lift and only a short drift; see blocking defects. Elsewhere contact reads: the wheel enters the water with spray at 34.8 s, stamps press at 26.8 s and 40.4 s, and the door opens at 51.2-51.8 s.

surface_finish.observed: Thin lip with no white water and a box-shaped shelf with straight edges in the creek. The other scenes look finished for the flat illustrated style.

closing_payoff.observed: The open-door car at the airport bay, the record card reading 'The remedy is currently under development.' with its stamp, then a split frame of curb over desk with the words underlined (56.4-58.4 s).

story_review.one_viewing_summary: A driverless car picks up at a San Antonio airport curb. The service began in a 60 square mile area. Two disclosed April floods follow. Then come the recall record, its sentence acted out on a lane, the remedy stamped 'under development', and the interim limits by April 20. It closes on the open ride beside the record.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on the open ride and closes on the open ride held beside the unfinished remedy.
story_review.weakest_transition: s2 to s3 at 13.2 s: a tabletop map cuts to a straight-down creek roof; recognition relies on the pod and the disclosure.

strongest_frame: 34.0-35.8 s: the wheel enters the water and 'may' lights.
